title: Apple and AT&T Announce iTunes Activation and Sync for iPhone
lineage: Apple and AT&T state that US launch activation required an Internet-connected PC or Mac with iTunes, payment or an iTunes account, an eligible Social Security number, and a new two-year AT&T plan.
